This is a series competition with [Northside Spring Saturday 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthsideSpringSaturday2022).  You may register for **ONLY ONE** competition in the series.  If you register for both, your registration will only be accepted for one of the competitions. Please note that each competition has a different set of events.
